kind: Actual inherited workspace documents, not synthetic attack observations

report.coordinates: Zero-based half-open original byte ranges and event indexes; one-based lines/byte columns; only LF increments the line.
report.model: Lexical scopes: PDF closes a top embedding but never crosses an isolate; PDI ends the nearest isolate and its inner embeddings; Unicode B-class characters end open scopes; EOF retains open-at-eof.
limitations: Not the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm or a display-order prediction.
No embedding levels, depth overflow, FSI direction, paired-bracket or glyph analysis.
Rendering depth limits may cause actual controls to be ignored differently.
Literal UTF-8 only: no JSON/source escapes, HTML markup or language parsing.
Controls can be legitimate; balanced scopes do not establish safety or intent.
Does not detect lookalikes, other invisible characters or all Unicode risks.
Contexts are unredacted, at most 16 bytes per side, and may split UTF-8 characters.
All totals and relationships computed before detail truncation; referenced indexes may be omitted. Increase max_details to inspect them (up to 1000).
Hashes identify bytes, not authorship, authenticity or trustworthy provenance.
